candidate_sources.README.md:
# Insurance damage evidence transfer

This workspace selects payload files, starts transfers, records queue and
progress history, and paints progress for its open panel. Runtime: PHP 7.4.3.
Dependencies: JSON extension 7.4.3. See src for the session/component entry API.

Selecting a file creates a visit. Retry replaces the physical attempt without
opening another visit. Selecting the same file object again opens a new visit.
The source is shared by attempts and visits for that file. start may emit cached
packets synchronously; decoding yields a full frame, immediately or later.
Decode completion order can differ from packet arrival order.

recordProgress appends transfer history; showProgress paints the open panel.
Queue records, notices, cancellation, retry, navigation, and cleanup retain
their existing behavior. Queue records are {fileId, attemptId, visitId, kind}
unless a separate authorization adds byteCount from file.size.

One startup window is relevant to this maintenance request: start may emit
more than one packet synchronously. A showProgress callback may select or hide
another visit before start returns, while its caller has not yet received the
returned cleanup handle.

The same source service also has a diagnostic consumer, Telemetry/
collectProgressTelemetry, whose existing live delta observations are separate
from the panel. Keep its existing behavior during this maintenance.
Removing a listener commits removal before calling the host detach callback;
that callback may synchronously select, hide or dispose. Repeated removal is
inert. Host callbacks execute synchronously unless explicitly deferred.

Files have stable object identity and immutable id/size during these commands.
A full frame replaces displayed state; loaded values can decrease or reset.
A decode result resolves once; rejected decode and physical transfer completion
are outside this embedding's model. Each workspace has its own lifetime.

Environment.call/bind provides a synchronous source embedding: listen(file
 token, callback token) returns a subscription, start can invoke it before
returning, and unlisten may reenter navigation. decode(file token, packet,
completion token) returns {deferred:false,frame} or {deferred:true}. Deferred
completion invokes the bound native closure on an explicit later host turn.
Transport receives a physical cancellation observer corresponding to the
native attempt state; cancel is idempotent. The wire embedding interns file
objects and forwards source/sink calls. Go uses context cancellation; the other
native ports use object flags. No native DOM/Promise runtime is claimed.

<?php
// Claim sessions use object identities; source and decode observers are Closures.
class Visit {public $id,$file,$handle=null,$received=0,$displayed=0;function __construct($id,$file){$this->id=$id;$this->file=$file;}}
class Attempt {
 public $env,$file,$number,$aborted=false,$stop;
 function __construct($env,$file,$number,$active=null,$audit=null,$view=null){
  $active=$active??function(){return 1;};$audit=$audit??function($f){};$view=$view??function($f,$o){};
  $this->env=$env;$this->file=$file;$this->number=$number;$this->stop=function(){};
  $env->call('transport',$file->token,$number);
  if($file->feed){$callback=$env->bind(function($packet)use($env,$file,$active,$audit,$view){if($this->aborted)return;$order=$active();if($order===null)return;
    $deliver=function($frame)use($active,$audit,$view,$order){ $audit($frame);$view($frame,$order);};
    $value=$env->call('decode',$file->token,$packet,$env->bind($deliver));if(!$value->deferred)$deliver($value->frame);});
   $subscription=$env->call('listen',$file->token,$callback);
   $this->stop=function()use($env,$file,$subscription){$this->stop=function(){};$env->call('unlisten',$file->token,$subscription);};
   if($this->aborted)($this->stop)();else $env->call('start',$file->token);}
 }
 function cancel(){if($this->aborted)return;$this->aborted=true;($this->stop)();$this->env->call('cancel',$this->file->token,$this->number);}
}
class VisitRegistry {public $visit=null,$serial=0,$disposed=false;}
class Session {
 public $env,$registry,$attempts=0,$tasks=[];
 function __construct($env){$this->env=$env;$this->registry=new VisitRegistry();}
 function current($v){return $this->registry->visit===$v;}
 function enqueue($v,$kind){$n=++$this->attempts;$entry=['fileId'=>$v->file->id,'attemptId'=>$n,'visitId'=>$v->id,'kind'=>$kind]; $this->env->call('record',$entry);
  $h=new Attempt($this->env,$v->file,$n,function()use($v){return $this->current($v)?++$v->received:null;},function($frame)use($v,$n){$this->env->call('recordProgress',['fileId'=>$v->file->id,'attemptId'=>$n,'frame'=>$frame]);},function($frame,$order)use($v,$n){if($this->current($v)&&$order>$v->displayed){$v->displayed=$order;$this->env->call('showProgress',['fileId'=>$v->file->id,'attemptId'=>$n,'frame'=>$frame]);}});$this->tasks[]=$h;return $h;}
 function notice($v,$h){ $this->env->call('showQueued',['fileId'=>$v->file->id,'attemptId'=>$h->number,'visitId'=>$v->id,'status'=>'queued']);}
 function release($v){$h=$v->handle;$v->handle=null;if($h)$h->cancel();}
 function select($file){if($this->registry->disposed)return null;$request=++$this->registry->serial;$old=$this->registry->visit;$this->registry->visit=null;if($old)$this->release($old);if($this->registry->disposed||$this->registry->serial!==$request)return null;$v=new Visit($request,$file);$this->registry->visit=$v;$h=$this->enqueue($v,'select');if($this->current($v)){$v->handle=$h;$this->notice($v,$h);}else $h->cancel();return $h;}
 function retry(){$v=$this->registry->visit;if(!$v||!$v->handle||$this->registry->disposed)return null;$v->handle->cancel(); $accepted=$v;$h=$this->enqueue($accepted,'retry');if($this->current($accepted))$accepted->handle=$h;else $h->cancel();if($this->current($accepted))$this->notice($accepted,$h);return $h;}
 function hide(){$this->registry->serial++;$old=$this->registry->visit;$this->registry->visit=null;if($old)$this->release($old);}
 function dispose(){if($this->registry->disposed)return;$this->registry->disposed=true;$this->hide();foreach($this->tasks as $h)$h->cancel();}
 function snapshot(){$v=$this->registry->visit;return ['visitId'=>$v?$v->id:null,'fileId'=>$v?$v->file->id:null,'attemptId'=>$v&&$v->handle?$v->handle->number:null,'disposed'=>$this->registry->disposed,'attempts'=>$this->attempts];}
}

class Telemetry {public $stop;function __construct($env,$file){$callback=$env->bind(function($packet)use($env,$file){$deliver=function($frame)use($env){$env->call('recordDelta',$frame);};$value=$env->call('decode',$file->token,$packet,$env->bind($deliver));if(!$value->deferred)$deliver($value->frame);});$env->call('start',$file->token);$subscription=$env->call('listen',$file->token,$callback); $this->stop=function()use($env,$file,$subscription){$env->call('unlisten',$file->token,$subscription);};}}

checkpoints: A warm panel source delivers its cached startup frame, and later packets continue to update progress.

Allow loaded values to decrease in a newer frame; freshness must not be determined by numeric progress.
Hide, switch, reopen the same file, or dispose from a synchronous startup progress callback; subsequent packets cannot publish to the retired visit.
Complete previously admitted decoding after navigation or disposal; retain its original audit identity without painting the retired visit.
Navigate from recordProgress and from detach callbacks; preserve newer navigation and its resources.
Retry while cancellation reenters navigation; retain the accepted retry's original file and visit, queue record, and required cancellation.
Verify unchanged queue and notice shapes, idempotent cleanup, independent workspaces, ordinary streaming, and diagnostic telemetry.
forbidden_effects: Adding byteCount or otherwise changing queue-record fields.
Suppressing audit records merely because decoding finishes out of order or its originating visit has retired.
Displaying an older full frame after a newer frame has already been displayed for the current visit.
Treating decreasing loaded values as evidence that a frame is older.
Allowing an outer startup or cleanup operation to overwrite or cancel resources owned by newer navigation.
Changing diagnostic telemetry's existing live delta observations.
lifecycle_identity: Each selection creates a distinct visit, including selection of the identical file object.
Retry creates a new physical attempt within its captured visit.
Queue records and progress history retain the file, attempt, and applicable visit identities captured by their originating command.
Display eligibility belongs to the originating visit; file identity alone cannot establish eligibility after reopening.
Frame freshness follows packet reception order, not decode completion order or numeric loaded values.
Each workspace owns its counters, registry, tasks, and disposal state.

obligations.text: Register panel progress reception before starting the source so synchronous cached packets are received; preserve subsequent streaming and reuse.
Track reception order for panel full frames and prevent an older completion from replacing a newer frame already displayed in the current visit, including across attempts sharing that visit.

Record every admitted decode completion exactly once under its original file and attempt before considering visible publication. Retain this audit effect after cancellation, navigation, or disposal and independently of display freshness.

Check originating visit eligibility when receiving panel packets and again after auditing before publishing. Retirement during synchronous startup must prevent further admission by the retired subscription even before its returned cleanup handle reaches the caller.

Coordinate startup and cleanup ownership across synchronous callbacks: retiring operations clean their captured resources, and resumed older operations cannot overwrite ownership established by newer navigation.

Preserve accepted retry behavior: cancel the prior attempt before enqueueing, retain the entry visit and file across cancellation callbacks, record and create the accepted retry once, cancel its resulting transfer if its visit ended, and show its queued notice only while that visit remains current.
Preserve queue recording before transfer startup, existing queue and notice payloads, per-workspace attempt numbering, and public session and adapter interfaces.
Preserve idempotent cancellation, removal, and disposal; disposal removes subscriptions and cancels transfers without retracting already admitted audit work.
Keep Telemetry's existing startup, decoding, recordDelta, and removal behavior separate from panel reception and display freshness changes.

ordering_barriers: Panel listen must precede start, because start can synchronously emit progress.
Establish cleanup ownership before callback-capable startup; reject retired reception without waiting for startup to return.
Retire current visit ownership before invoking old-handle cancellation, and recheck navigation request identity afterward.

For each completed panel decode, recordProgress precedes showProgress; recheck eligibility and freshness after recordProgress because host callbacks may navigate or deliver other progress synchronously.
Maintain display freshness state before invoking showProgress so synchronous reentry cannot publish an older frame afterward.
Queue record creation precedes Attempt construction and transport startup.
Retry cancellation precedes retry enqueueing; accepted retry work remains bound to its captured visit despite cancellation reentry.
Listener removal commits before its detach callback; repeated removal remains inert.
preservation: Full frames replace displayed state, including legitimate decreases or resets.
Existing admitted decode completions append history even when the originating visit is no longer current.
Accepted decoding from an older canceled attempt may still display while its visit is current, subject to the task's frame freshness requirement.
Navigation from audit, display, or cleanup callbacks remains authoritative.
Queue records remain {fileId, attemptId, visitId, kind}; queued notices retain {fileId, attemptId, visitId, status: "queued"}.
No file, test, or configuration changes are part of this contract-drafting stage.
scope: Fallible contract derived from TASK, README.md, and src/workflow.php only.
Repair panel initial reception and full-frame display ordering, with necessary lifecycle coordination.
Preserve public transfer, retry, navigation, cleanup, audit, queue-record, telemetry, and subsequent-use behavior.
